```yaml
name: GlobalLeaks Directory Refresh

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_refresh:
        description: 'Force refresh even if no changes detected'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      dry_run:
        description: 'Run in dry-run mode (no commits)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  refresh-globaleaks-directory:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests beautifulsoup4 lxml pyyaml

      - name: Fetch and Normalize GlobalLeaks Data
        id: fetch_data
        run: |
          # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p data/globaleaks
          
          # Run the refresh script
          # This script should:
          # 1. Fetch data from the Shodan-derived list or other source
          # 2. Normalize entries (deduplication, field validation)
          # 3. Generate JSON index for search
          # 4. Generate individual listing pages if needed
          python scripts/refresh_globaleaks_directory.py \
            --output-dir data/globaleaks \
            --index-file data/globaleaks/index.json \
            --force-refresh ${{ github.event.inputs.force_refresh == 'true' }} \
            --dry-run ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run == 'true' }}
          
          # Set output for commit message
          echo "files_changed=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git_status
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.git_status.outputs.has_changes == 'true' && github.event.inputs.dry_run != 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add data/globaleaks/
          git commit -m "chore: refresh GlobalLeaks directory data [skip ci]" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Create Pull Request (if dry run or push failed)
        if: steps.git_status.outputs.has_changes == 'true' && (github.event.inputs.dry_run == 'true' || failure())
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: refresh GlobalLeaks directory data"
          title: "chore: refresh GlobalLeaks directory data"
          body: |
            Automated refresh of GlobalLeaks directory data.
            
            This PR updates the GlobalLeaks listings based on the latest available data.
            
            Changes:
            - Updated instance listings
            - Refreshed search index
          branch: chore/refresh-globaleaks-directory
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            automation
            directory-refresh
```
